glossary.definition: (A) "Aggregator site" means a web site that provides access to information regarding insurance products from more than one insurer, including product and insurer information, for use in comparison shopping.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3905.064 to 3905.0611 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Blanket travel insurance" means a policy of travel insurance issued to any eligible group providing coverage for specific classes of persons defined in the policy with coverage provided to all members of the eligible group without a separate charge to individual members of the eligible group.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3905.064 to 3905.0611 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "Cancellation fee waiver" means a contractual agreement between a supplier of travel services and its customer to waive some or all of the nonrefundable cancellation fee provisions of the supplier's underlying travel contract, with or without regard to the reason for the cancellation or form of reimbursement.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3905.064 to 3905.0611 of the Revised Code:
As used in sections 3905.064 to 3905.0611 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (E) "Fulfillment materials" means documentation sent to the purchaser of a travel protection plan confirming the purchase and providing the travel protection plan's coverage and assistance details.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3905.064 to 3905.0611 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (F) "Group travel insurance" means travel insurance issued to any eligible group.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3905.064 to 3905.0611 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (G) "Limited lines travel insurance agent" means an individual or business entity licensed to sell, solicit, or negotiate travel insurance under section 3905.065 of the Revised Code. "Limited lines travel insurance agent" includes a licensed insurance agent and a travel administrator.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3905.064 to 3905.0611 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (H) "Offer and sell" means providing general information, including a description of the coverage and price, as well as processing the application and collecting premiums.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3905.064 to 3905.0611 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (I) "Primary certificate holder" means an individual person who elects and purchases travel insurance under a group policy.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3905.064 to 3905.0611 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (J) "Primary policyholder" means an individual person who elects and purchases individual travel insurance.

glossary.definition: (N) "Travel insurer" means an insurer, as defined in section 3901.32 of the Revised Code, that provides travel insurance.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3905.064 to 3905.0611 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (O) "Travel protection plan" means a plan that provides one or more of the following: travel insurance, travel assistance services, and cancellation fee waivers.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3905.064 to 3905.0611 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition:
(P) "Travel retailer" means a business entity that makes, arranges, or offers travel services, and that may offer or sell travel insurance as a service to its customers on behalf of, and under the direction of, a limited lines travel insurance agent in conjunction with the making, arranging, or offering of travel services.
